def summarize_window(feed, size):
    """Read the next `size` shipments from the feed and return (peak weight, list of weight).

    The feed may be endless. Exactly `size` items are read from it.
    """
    window = list(itertools.islice(feed, size))
    peak = max(x.weight for x in window)
    values = [x.weight for x in window]
    return peak, values

def summarize_window(feed, size):
    """Read the next `size` shipments from the feed and return (peak weight, list of weight).

    The feed may be endless. Exactly `size` items are read from it.
    """
    feed = list(feed)
    window = itertools.islice(feed, size)
    peak = max(x.weight for x in window)
    values = [x.weight for x in window]
    return peak, values
